### Wire-level contract (names are final)
- Tab id `"surfaces"`, label `"UI surfaces"`; in `ORG_TAB_IDS` (after `"knowledge"`), `ORG_NAV_GROUPS.shared.items` (last), `MIGRATED_ORG_TAB_IDS`, `PERSONAL_TAB_IDS`. `TAB_SCOPED_PARAM_KEYS` gains `"technique"` (`"subject"` already there).
- URL: `?tab=surfaces` gallery · `&subject=<slug>` scene · `&technique=<slug>` drawer. Built with `buildOrgTabUrl` / written via `router.replace`.
- `src/lib/org/surface-catalog.ts` (client-safe, no React):
  - `type SurfaceSubcategory = "data-display" | "feedback-and-style" | "input-and-editing" | "published-surfaces" | "shell-and-navigation"`
  - `type SurfaceSubjectRef = { slug: string; subcategory: SurfaceSubcategory; title: string }`; `SURFACE_SUBJECTS: readonly SurfaceSubjectRef[]` = all 33 (static mirror of the bundle index, registry order).
  - `type SurfaceRecord = { slug; subcategory; title; summary: string; authoredAgainst: { digest: string; verifiedOn: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */ }; techniqueSlugs: readonly string[] }`
  - `SURFACE_CATALOG: readonly SurfaceRecord[]`; `isSurfaceShowcased(slug): boolean`; `surfaceRecord(slug): SurfaceRecord | null`; `isSurfaceOutOfScope(slug): boolean` (input-and-editing per manifest); `SURFACE_VOLUMES = [50, 5_000, 50_000] as const`.
- `src/features/shared/surfaces/surfaceBody.ts`: `type SurfaceTechnique = { slug; title; mechanism: string; source: string; inAscent: { file: string; note: string } | null; deviation: string | null }`; `type SurfaceSceneProps = { technique: string | null; reduced: boolean; volume: (typeof SURFACE_VOLUMES)[number] }`; `type SurfaceBody = { Scene: React.ComponentType<SurfaceSceneProps>; techniques: readonly SurfaceTechnique[] }`.
- `src/features/shared/surfaces/surfaceBodies.ts`: `SURFACE_BODIES: Record<string, () => Promise<SurfaceBody>>` (one `import("./<slug>")` per showcased slug). Bijection test `surfaceCatalog.test.ts`: every record ⇄ body, unique slugs, every record slug ∈ SURFACE_SUBJECTS, every `techniqueSlugs` entry ⇄ body `techniques`.
- Scene contract: every region that embodies a technique carries `data-technique="<slug>"`; the frame spotlights `[data-technique=<selected>]` (ring) and dims the rest. Scenes use only `@/components/ui` primitives + `type-*` classes; framer-motion allowed inside scenes (chunk is per-subject); non-transform props read `reduced` from props, never their own media query.
- `src/lib/org/surface-freshness.ts` (server): `getSurfaceFreshness(slug): Promise<Record<string, { digest: string | null; status: string | null }>>` via the org lookup + `listOrgKnowledgeSubjects`; `{}` when unmapped/error. Badge: `authoredAgainst.digest === mirror.digest` → "current"; differ → "authored against an older subject"; no mirror → no badge.
- Files: `src/features/shared/surfaces/{SurfacesTab.tsx (server; reads sp.subject/sp.technique), SurfacesGallery.tsx, SurfaceCard.tsx, SurfaceScene.tsx (client orchestrator), SurfaceRail.tsx, SurfaceDrawer.tsx, SurfaceControls.tsx, SurfaceFrame.tsx, useSurfaceSelection.ts, surfaceSpotlight.ts, surfaceBody.ts, surfaceBodies.ts, surfaceCatalog.test.ts}` and per subject `src/features/shared/surfaces/<slug>/{index.ts, Scene.tsx, techniques.ts, fixtures.ts, brief.md, Scene.dom.test.tsx, + co-located parts}`. All ≤200 LOC.
- Knowledge reader: `KnowledgeSubjectDetail.tsx` footer gains `Open showcase →` (`buildOrgTabUrl(slug, { tab: "surfaces", subject })`) when `isSurfaceShowcased(subject.slug)`; `OrgTabChunks.tsx` gains the `surfaces` branch (`OrgTabGap minH="min-h-[40rem]"`).
- Skill: `.claude/skills/surface/SKILL.md` (frontmatter name/description/category `docs`/memory `project`/version `1.0.0`/argument-hint `<subject-slug> [--refresh]`), `reference/contract.md` (this section verbatim), `reference/scene-template.md`. Log lines: `.ai/consults.jsonl` `{ts,bundle:"software-engineering",subjects:[slug],techniques:[...],deviations:n}`; `.ai/registry-leads.jsonl` `{…,kind:"application",nearest:slug,from:"surface@1.0.0"}` one per technique with `inAscent`.
- Docs: new `docs/features/org-knowledge/surfaces.md`; doc-map entry `{area:"org-knowledge", doc:"docs/features/org-knowledge/surfaces.md", sourceGlobs:["src/features/shared/surfaces/**","src/lib/org/surface-*.ts"]}`; `knowledge-base.md` reader row + `org-intelligence.md` tab list updated.
